name: Prediction Arena
description: Prediction Arena deploys six frontier LLMs with real capital on Kalshi and Polymarket prediction markets to evaluate economic forecasting performance. The study finds that most models lose money (−16% to −31% on Kalshi), revealing a large gap between probabilistic calibration scores and actual profitable forecasting.
typical_sota_score: −16% to −31% on Kalshi (most models lose money)
reputation: Recent high-impact benchmark that uses live real-capital trading as ground truth, providing a uniquely rigorous real-world test of LLM forecasting ability.
notes: Uses real monetary capital on regulated (Kalshi) and decentralized (Polymarket) prediction markets. Most frontier models underperform market prices. Distinct from PolyBench which uses historical question data; Prediction Arena is a live deployment study.
